versos.hebraico: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיַּצִּ֣יגוּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽטָה־ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּקְרִ֛יבוּ עֹל֥וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: They brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
controles.kjv: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
controles.livre: Trouxeram, pois, a arca de Deus, e a puseram no meio da tenda que Davi tinha lhe armado; e apresentaram ofertas de queima e sacrifícios de gratidão diante de Deus.

versos.hebraico: וַיְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔יד מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: When David had made an end of offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.
controles.kjv: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
controles.livre: E Davi, quando terminou de apresentar as ofertas de queima e os sacrifícios de gratidão, abençoou ao povo em nome do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחַלֵּק֙ לְכָל־אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁ֑ה לְאִישׁ֙ כִּכַּר־לֶ֔חֶם וְאֶשְׁפָּ֖ר וַאֲשִׁישָֽׁה׃

controles.web: He dealt to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
controles.kjv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
controles.livre: E repartiu a todos em Israel, tanto homens como mulheres, a cada um um bolo de pão, uma boa porção de carne, e um bolo de passas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֞ן לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָׁרְתִ֑ים וּלְהַזְכִּיר֙ וּלְהוֹד֣וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֔ל לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

controles.web: He appointed certain of the Levites to minister before Yahweh’s ark, and to celebrate and to thank and praise Yahweh, the God of Israel:
controles.kjv: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to record, and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:
controles.livre: E pôs diante do arca do SENHOR a alguns dos levitas como servidores, para que celebrassem, agradecessem, e louvassem ao SENHOR Deus de Israel:

versos.hebraico: אָסָ֥ף הָרֹ֖אשׁ וּמִשְׁנֵ֣הוּ זְכַרְיָ֑ה יְעִיאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִֽיחִיאֵ֡ל וּמַתִּתְיָ֡ה וֶאֱלִיאָ֡ב וּבְנָיָהוּ֩ וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֜ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֗ל בִּכְלֵ֤י נְבָלִים֙ וּבְכִנֹּר֔וֹת וְאָסָ֖ף בַּֽמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם מַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃

controles.web: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
controles.kjv: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed–edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
controles.livre: Asafe era o cabeça, e Zacarias era o segundo depois; Jeiel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Matitias, Eliabe, Benaia, Obede-Edom, e Jeiel, estavam com seus instrumentos de saltérios e harpas, mas Asafe fazia som com címbalos;

versos.hebraico: וּבְנָיָ֥הוּ וְיַחֲזִיאֵ֖ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בַּחֲצֹצְר֣וֹת תָּמִ֔יד לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
controles.kjv: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
controles.livre: Porém os sacerdotes Benaia e Jaaziel estavam continuamente com trombetas diante do arca do pacto de Deus.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אָ֣ז נָתַ֤ן דָּוִיד֙ בָּרֹ֔אשׁ לְהֹד֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה בְּיַד־אָסָ֖ף וְאֶחָֽיו׃פ

controles.web: Then on that day David first ordained to give thanks to Yahweh, by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
controles.kjv: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the Lord into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
controles.livre: Então naquele mesmo dia Davi pela primeira vez mandou celebrarem ao SENHOR por meio de Asafe e de seus irmãos:

versos.hebraico: הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָעַמִּ֖ים עֲלִילֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make his doings known among the peoples.
controles.kjv: Give thanks unto the Lord, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
controles.livre: Louvai ao SENHOR, invocai o seu nome, notificai entre os povos os seus feitos.

versos.hebraico: שִׁ֤ירוּ לוֹ֙ זַמְּרוּ־ל֔וֹ שִׂ֖יחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
controles.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
controles.livre: Cantai a ele, cantai-lhe salmos; falai de todas as suas maravilhas.

versos.hebraico: הִֽתְהַֽלְלוּ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֔וֹ יִשְׂמַ֕ח לֵ֖ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
controles.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.
controles.livre: Gloriai-vos em seu santo nome; alegre-se o coração dos que buscam ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: דִּרְשׁ֤וּ יְהוָה֙ וְעֻזּ֔וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֥וּ פָנָ֖יו תָּמִֽיד׃

controles.web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
controles.kjv: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.
controles.livre: Procurai ao SENHOR e à sua força; buscai a sua face continuamente.

versos.hebraico: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה מֹפְתָ֖יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיהוּ׃

controles.web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
controles.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
controles.livre: Lembrai-vos de suas maravilhas que ele fez, de seus prodígios, e dos juízos de sua boca,

versos.hebraico: זֶ֚רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֔וֹ בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃

controles.web: you seed of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
controles.kjv: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
controles.livre: Vós, descendentes  de seu servo Israel, vós filhos de Jacó, seus escolhidos.

versos.hebraico: ה֚וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃

controles.web: He is Yahweh our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
controles.kjv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
controles.livre: Ele é o SENHOR, o nosso Deus; seus juízos estão em toda a terra.

versos.hebraico: זִכְר֤וּ לְעוֹלָם֙ בְּרִית֔וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
controles.kjv: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
controles.livre: Lembrai-vos perpetuamente de seu pacto, e da palavra que ele mandou até mil gerações;

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַת֙ אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֔ם וּשְׁבוּעָת֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃

controles.web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
controles.kjv: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
controles.livre: Do pacto que estabeleceu com Abraão, e do seu juramento a Isaque;

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲמִידֶ֤הָ לְיַעֲקֹב֙ לְחֹ֔ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: He confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
controles.kjv: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
controles.livre: O qual confirmou a Jacó por estatuto, a Israel por pacto eterno,

versos.hebraico: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֔עַן חֶ֖בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
controles.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
controles.livre: Dizendo: A ti darei a terra de Canaã, a porção de vossa herança;

versos.hebraico: בִּֽהְיֽוֹתְכֶם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר כִּמְעַ֖ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners were in it.
controles.kjv: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
controles.livre: Quando vós éreis poucos em número, poucos, e estrangeiros nela;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ֙ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־גּ֔וֹי וּמִמַּמְלָכָ֖ה אֶל־עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃

controles.web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
controles.kjv: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
controles.livre: Que andavam de nação em nação, de um reino a outro povo.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־הִנִּ֤יחַ לְאִישׁ֙ לְעָשְׁקָ֔ם וַיּ֥וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מְלָכִֽים׃

controles.web: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
controles.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
controles.livre: A ninguém ele permitiu que os oprimisse; por causa deles repreendeu a reis,

versos.hebraico: אַֽל־תִּגְּעוּ֙ בִּמְשִׁיחָ֔י וּבִנְבִיאַ֖י אַל־תָּרֵֽעוּ׃פ

controles.web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
controles.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
controles.livre: Dizendo : Não toqueis em meus ungidos, nem façais mal a meus profetas.

versos.hebraico: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־אֶל־י֖וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
controles.kjv: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
controles.livre: Cantai ao SENHOR, toda a terra, anunciai de dia em dia sua salvação.

versos.hebraico: סַפְּר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֶת־כְּבוֹד֔וֹ בְּכָל־הָעַמִּ֖ים נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
controles.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
controles.livre: Cantai entre as nações sua glória, e entre todos os povos suas maravilhas.

versos.hebraico: כִּי֩ גָד֨וֹל יְהוָ֤ה וּמְהֻלָּל֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְנוֹרָ֥א ה֖וּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
controles.kjv: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR é grande, e muito digno de ser louvado; ele é mais temível que todos os deuses.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֠י כָּל־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָעַמִּים֙ אֱלִילִ֔ים וַיהוָ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃

controles.web: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
controles.kjv: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
controles.livre: Pois todos os deuses dos povos nada são; porém o SENHOR fez os céus.

versos.hebraico: ה֤וֹד וְהָדָר֙ לְפָנָ֔יו עֹ֥ז וְחֶדְוָ֖ה בִּמְקֹמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
controles.kjv: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
controles.livre: Majestade e esplendor há diante de ele; força e alegria em sua morada.

versos.hebraico: הָב֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֔ים הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

controles.web: Ascribe to Yahweh, you relatives of the peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength!
controles.kjv: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.
controles.livre: Reconhecei ao SENHOR, ó famílias das nações, reconhecei ao SENHOR a glória e o poder.

versos.hebraico: הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂא֤וּ מִנְחָה֙ וּבֹ֣אוּ לְפָנָ֔יו הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
controles.kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
controles.livre: Dai ao SENHOR a glória de seu nome; trazei ofertas, e vinde diante dele; adorai ao SENHOR na glória de sua santidade.

versos.hebraico: חִ֤ילוּ מִלְּפָנָיו֙ כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אַף־תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּבֵ֖ל בַּל־תִּמּֽוֹט׃

controles.web: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
controles.kjv: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
controles.livre: Assombrai-vos diante dele, vós, toda a terra; o mundo por ele foi estabelecido, para que não se movesse.

versos.hebraico: יִשְׂמְח֤וּ הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיֹאמְר֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה מָלָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”
controles.kjv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The Lord reigneth.
controles.livre: Alegrem-se os céus, e goze-se a terra, e digam nas nações: Reina o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: יִרְעַ֤ם הַיָּם֙ וּמְלוֹא֔וֹ יַעֲלֹ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is therein!
controles.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
controles.livre: Ressoe o mar, e a plenitude dela: Alegre-se o campo, e todo o que contém.

versos.hebraico: אָ֥ז יְרַנְּנ֖וּ עֲצֵ֣י הַיָּ֑עַר מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־בָ֖א לִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.
controles.kjv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, because he cometh to judge the earth.
controles.livre: Então cantarão as árvores dos bosques diante do SENHOR, Porque vem a julgar a terra.

versos.hebraico: הוֹד֤וּ לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
controles.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
controles.livre: Celebrai a o SENHOR, porque é bom; Porque sua misericórdia é eterna.

versos.hebraico: וְאִמְר֕וּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔נוּ וְקַבְּצֵ֥נוּ וְהַצִּילֵ֖נוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לְהֹדוֹת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֔ךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּ֖חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
controles.kjv: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.
controles.livre: E dizei: Salva-nos, ó Deus, saúde nossa: Junta-nos, e livra-nos das nações, Para que confessemos tua santo nome, e nos gloriemos em teus louvores.

versos.hebraico: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־הָעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַ֣ד הָעֹלָ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ כָל־הָעָם֙ אָמֵ֔ן וְהַלֵּ֖ל לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting.    All the people said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.
controles.livre: Bendito seja o SENHOR Deus de Israel, De eternidade a eternidade.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּֽעֲזָב־שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֔ה לְאָסָ֖ף וּלְאֶחָ֑יו לְשָׁרֵ֞ת לִפְנֵ֧י הָאָר֛וֹן תָּמִ֖יד לִדְבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: So he left there, before the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, Asaph and his brothers, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
controles.kjv: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:
controles.livre: E deixou ali, diante do arca do pacto do SENHOR, a Asafe e a seus irmãos, para que ministrassem de contínuo diante da arca, cada coisa em seu dia:

versos.hebraico: וְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֑ה וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֧ם בֶּן־יְדִית֛וּן וְחֹסָ֖ה לְשֹׁעֲרִֽים׃

controles.web: and Obed-Edom with their brothers, sixty-eight; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
controles.kjv: And Obed–edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed–edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
controles.livre: E a Obede-Edom e a seus irmãos, sessenta e oito; e a Obede-Edom filho de Jedutum, e a Hosa, por porteiros:

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣ת׀ צָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאֶחָיו֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה בַּבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃

controles.web: and Zadok the priest, and his brothers the priests, before Yahweh’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
controles.kjv: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,
controles.livre: Assim a Zadoque o sacerdote, e a seus irmãos os sacerdotes, diante do tabernáculo do SENHOR no alto que estava em Gibeão,

versos.hebraico: לְֽהַעֲלוֹת֩ עֹל֨וֹת לַיהוָ֜ה עַל־מִזְבַּ֧ח הָעֹלָ֛ה תָּמִ֖יד לַבֹּ֣קֶר וְלָעָ֑רֶב וּלְכָל־הַכָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in Yahweh’s law, which he commanded to Israel;
controles.kjv: To offer burnt offerings unto the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;
controles.livre: Para que sacrificassem continuamente, a manhã e tarde, holocaustos a o SENHOR no altar do holocausto, conforme a todo o que está escrito na lei do SENHOR, que ele prescreveu a Israel;

versos.hebraico: וְעִמָּהֶם֙ הֵימָ֣ן וִֽידוּת֔וּן וּשְׁאָר֙ הַבְּרוּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לְהֹדוֹת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;
controles.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever;
controles.livre: E com eles a Hemã e a Jedutum, e os outros escolhidos declarados por seus nomes, para glorificar a o SENHOR, porque é eterna sua misericórdia;

versos.hebraico: וְעִמָּהֶם֩ הֵימָ֨ן וִֽידוּת֜וּן חֲצֹצְר֤וֹת וּמְצִלְתַּ֨יִם֙ לְמַשְׁמִיעִ֔ים וּכְלֵ֖י שִׁ֣יר הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבְנֵ֥י יְדוּת֖וּן לַשָּֽׁעַר׃

controles.web: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
controles.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
controles.livre: Com eles a Hemã e a Jedutum com trombetas e címbalos para tanger, e com outros instrumentos de música de Deus; e a os filhos de Jedutum, por porteiros.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ כָל־הָעָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֑וֹ וַיִּסֹּ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד לְבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: All the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
controles.kjv: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
controles.livre: E todo o povo se foi cada um a sua casa; e Davi se voltou para abençoar sua casa.
